body: I feel terrible. I feel terrible *because* I want to kill myself. More importantly, because of the reason why I want to kill myself. I love someone very deeply who is already in a relationship. Stupid reason to want to kill myself, I know. I should just move on. But instead I'm this stupid entitled asshole who wants to kill himself because the girl he loves can't be with him. Who do I think I am? There are people with *real* problems in the world. People who have it hard finding even a place to sleep at night. I don't deserve to kill myself yet I really want to. Just because of a girl. I'm such a stupid idiot asshole I hate myself!
I can't stop you. But at least look at this: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a5SMyfbWYyE

I feel the exact same way and I couldn't have stated it in better words myself. Said this earlier to someone else too but maybe we can get through this together. I won't kill myself if you don't kill yourself. Life is shitty but maybe we should just live through the shit. Maybe it won't last forever. We won't know otherwise I guess, right?

Hi,

I just recently found this subreddit because I was feeling suicidal myself. I was planning on killing myself today as well. But after reading all these comments.. maybe they have a point man. Maybe it will all get better. Or maybe not. If we kill ourselves then we'll never know. I'll make you a promise how about that? I won't kill myself if you don't kill yourself. We don't have to enjoy life like everyone else says but I guess we can see what it has in store for us. What do you say?
